summary: Implemented new default products source module and updated ProductsWorkspace to use it; bumped localStorage drafts key/version with version-mismatch fallback. However, the diff summary does not provide enough evidence that all three requested default themes (including the third product) are present with full starter content, nor that “Generate All Products” triggers navigation to the Export screen.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the app loads three default products themed Digital Planner, Canva Templates, and Printable Wall Art, each prefilled with complete starter content (modules/chapters, prompts, templates, checklists) so users can generate all three products on first launch.
missing_requirements.reason: The added DEFAULT_PRODUCTS content is truncated and only clearly shows the full structure for product-1 and part of product-2; the diff summary does not show the third product (Printable Wall Art) nor confirm non-empty modules/prompts/templates/checklists for all three defaults.

missing_requirements.requirement: Clicking “Generate All Products” successfully produces 3 bundles and navigates to the Export screen with all three bundles available for download.
missing_requirements.reason: ProductsWorkspace calls the provided onBundlesGenerated callback after generateAllBundles(products), but no navigation-to-Export logic is shown in the provided diff summary. Whether navigation occurs in a parent component is not evidenced here.

hallucinated_features.description: Added drafts metadata fields and reset API (lastSaved timestamp in stored payload; resetDrafts() helper).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-25 asks to bump the draft storage version/key and provide a safe fallback for incompatible drafts; it does not request additional metadata or a reset function.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced more granular, user-friendly error messaging that distinguishes PDF vs ZIP failures during generation.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-24/REQ-25; it’s an extra behavior added alongside generation actions.
